observations: Two photos show an industrial machine with teal/white body, multiple rollers/heads, and a control panel with buttons/indicator lights.
The machine appears to be a paper/printing-related or packaging-related production machine (roller bed and feed path visible), but the exact type is not clearly readable.
Photo 0 shows the machine interior/working area with metal guides and a long feed path; photo 1 shows the operator side with a control panel and a large guard/cover.
No clear brand/model plate, nameplate, or readable model number is visible in either photo.

claims.evidence: Photos only show the machine; no running video, no error display, and no test output.
No readable manufacturer plate/label is visible in the photos.
No video/audio of the motor running or load testing is provided.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: No accessories/manual are shown in the photos.

claims.claim: never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service records, inspection stickers, or internal condition evidence is shown.

risks.risk: Exact machine type/model is unclear, so compatibility and correct parts/pricing cannot be confirmed from photos.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the machine nameplate/serial/model plate (front + side angles) and any label near the control panel.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case for an unknown industrial machine: assume missing/incorrect parts and reduced value until model/type is confirmed.

risks.risk: “Perfect working condition” may be overstated; machine may have faults under load (feed/jam issues, misalignment, worn rollers).
risks.proof: Short video of a full production cycle (start-up, feeding, operation, and completion) plus a close-up of any fault/error indicators during the run.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: needs servicing/repair) until a load test is shown.

risks.risk: Japanese-made claim may be wrong (could be rebranded/assembled elsewhere).
risks.proof: Nameplate photo showing manufacturer country and company name; also photo of any stamped markings on the motor/gearbox.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without assuming Japanese origin (worst-case: generic/unknown origin).

risks.risk: Accessories and original manual may be missing or incomplete (dies, guides, spare parts, tooling).
risks.proof: Photo inventory laid out on the floor/table: all accessories, manuals, and any tooling/dies with labels; include a checklist matching what’s included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing accessories/manual until shown.

risks.risk: Safety/condition risks: guards, wiring, and emergency stop may be incomplete or worn.
risks.proof: Photos of emergency stop, wiring compartment/cover condition, and all safety guards; plus a quick test of emergency stop (video).
risks.if_unproven: Priced with safety/condition uncertainty (worst-case: requires inspection/repairs).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the nameplate/serial/model plate (photo 0 and photo 1 angles).
Video of the machine running under load for a complete cycle (not just power-on).
Photos of all included accessories and the original manual (laid out and labeled).
Video or photo of emergency stop and safety guards functioning/installed.
response.reason: The photos show an industrial machine, but the exact type/model and working status cannot be verified remotely. Without a nameplate/model and a load-test video, any price would be guesswork; worst-case pricing is required until proof is provided.
